meta.name: hyperplan
meta.description: Adversarial multi-agent planning skill. Self-orchestrates 5 hostile category members (unspecified-low, unspecified-high, deep, ultrabrain, artistry) via team-mode for ruthless cross-critique debate, distills only the defensible insights, then MANDATORILY hands the distilled insight bundle to the `plan` agent for executable plan formalization. Use when planning needs maximum rigor and surfacing of weak assumptions, blind spots, and over-engineering. Triggers: 'hyperplan', 'hpp', '/hyperplan', 'adversarial plan', 'hostile planning', 'cross-critique plan', '하이퍼플랜', '적대적 계획', '교차 비평'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用对抗式多智能体辩论打磨出最严谨的计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果做重要决策时总担心遗漏关键假设或盲点。
copy.tagline_en: Sharpen plans through adversarial multi-agent debate
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to surface weak assumptions and blind spots in critical plans.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会启动一个由5个敌对成员组成的辩论团队，对用户的计划进行交叉批评，只保留经得起攻击的见解，然后强制交给“plan”代理生成可执行的计划。
howto.when: 当用户提出需要严格规划的任务，或说出“hyperplan”、“hpp”、“/hyperplan”、“adversarial plan”等触发词时触发。

say.text: 用 hyperplan 帮我规划这个项目。
say.note: 启动敌对多代理规划流程。

say.text: hpp 分析这个架构的弱点。
say.note: 触发敌对辩论，暴露架构缺陷。

say.text: 用 adversarial plan 审查我的计划。
say.note: 启动交叉批评，找出盲点。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude orchestrates a 5-member adversarial team to cross-critique the user's plan, distills only defensible insights, and mandatorily hands them to the 'plan' agent for executable plan formalization.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user requests rigorous planning or says 'hyperplan', 'hpp', '/hyperplan', 'adversarial plan', etc.

say_en.text: Use hyperplan to plan this project.

say_en.note: Triggers hostile debate to expose flaws.
Initiates cross-critique to surface blind spots.
